provenance.gatheredBy: load-sport-data, the 2026 NCAA Division I men's and women's tournaments as played: regions, seeds, pairings and every game's score from Wikipedia's tournament pages, cross-checked game by game against the ESPN tournament scoreboards, which agree on every pairing, seed, region and winner. Two women's scores differ by a point or two and the file takes ESPN's (North Carolina 82-51 Western Illinois, where Wikipedia has 83-51; Duke 69-46 Baylor, where Wikipedia has 69-48). Tip-offs (scheduledAt) are ESPN's. Each First Four game is a play-in place named for its pairing, whose winner is its playInWinner. Women's first and second round games at a top-16 seed's arena are marked home only where the host is on the bracket's home side; the other 13 are marked neutral. Ranking is seed line, then region. Odds to win are made up by seed.
